newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement up to 4.768 million gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement up to 4.768 million gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended August 24 was 4,768,835 gallons compared with 5,181,651 gallons last week.
Imports were 141,541 gallons compared with 247,404 gallons the previous week, and domestic receipts totaled 356,999 gallons versus 96,532 gallons a week ago.
Retail movement was 1,094,424 gallons compared with 1,016,119 gallons last year, while bulk movement was 3,037,322 gallons versus 4,052,974 gallons last year.
Current season cumulative movement was 202,953,457 gallons versus 197,680,186 a year ago.
Inventory was 93,319,604 versus 105,123,906 gallons last year.
The final total pack for the season is 202,353,371 gallons compared with 216,502,392 gallons a year ago.
